chapter.verse: Judah upa ahi Nikodemas kici, Farisaite lakah mi khat a om hi.

Tua pa zan lai takin Zeisu kiangah pai a, “Rabbi aw, nangmah in Pasian kiang pan hong pai thuhilhpa na hi cih kote in ka thei uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, na bawl nalamdangte Pasian in nangmah tawh a omkhawm kei leh, kuamah in a bawl thei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, mi khatpeuh mah in khatvei a suahkik kei leh, Pasian’ Gam a mu thei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Nikodemas in, “Mi khat a teek zawh ciangin bangci suakkik thei ding ahi hiam? A nu gil sungah tum kikin suakkik thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, mi khatpeuh in tui leh Kha Siangtho tawh a suakkik kei leh, Pasian’ Gam sungah a tum thei kei ding hi.
Ci-le-sa ah a piang mi in ci-le-sa ahi hi. Kha Siangtho ah a piang mi in kha ahi hi.
Khatvei na suakkik ding hi ka cihna lamdang sa kei in.
Huih in ama ut bangin a nung hi. Tua huih ging na zak hangin koi pan hong pai a, koilam pai ding cih na thei kei hi. Kha Siangtho tawh a suakte khempeuh in tua bang ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Nikodemas in, “Hih thute bangci piang zo ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin;
Zeisu in, “Nang in Israelte’ siapa na hi napi-in, hih thute thei lo na hi hiam?
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, kote in ka theih uh thu ka gen uh hi. Ka muhte uh teci ka pang uh hi. Ahih hangin kote’ teci pan’na na mang kei uh hi.
Leitung thu kong gen ciangin na up kei leh, vantung thu kong gen hangin bangci up ding na hi hiam?
Vantungah om a, vantung pan hong kumsuk Mihing Tapa khat longal kuamah vantungah a kahto ngei kei hi.”
“Moses in gamlakah gul a khai bangin Mihing Tapa a kikhai ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah a um mi khempeuh in nuntak tawntungna a ngah nading uh ahi hi.”
“Pasian in a Tapa a um mi khempeuhte in kisia lo a, nuntak tawntungna a ngah nadingin a Tapa khat bek a piak dongin leitung mite a it hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, leitung mite’ thukhen dingin Pasian in a Tapa leitungah hong paisak kei hi. Leitung mite in amah hangin gupna a ngah nadingun a hong paisak hi.
Amah a um mi in thukhenna a thuak kei hi. Amah a um lo mi ahih leh, tu-in thukhenna a thuak zo hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah in Pasian’ Tapa khat bek min a um kei hi.
Thukhenna thu in leitungah khuavakin hong tunga; mite in khuavak sangin khuamial a deihzaw uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amaute’ gamtatna man lo ahih hang hi.
A hoih lo-a gamta mi khempeuh in khuavak a mudah uh a; amau gamtatnate a kilat loh nadingin khuavakna-ah a pai kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin thuman a gamta mi in ama gamtatna Pasian’ deihna tawh kituak cih a kilatsak nadingin khuavakna-ah a pai hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua nung ciangin Zeisu a nungzuite tawh Judah gamah pai a, tuasan takah amaute tawh omkhawmin a baptaiz hi.
Johan in zong Salim tawh kinai Ainon khua-ah baptaiz-in a om hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tuasan takah tui tam a om hi.
Mite hong pai uh a, a kibaptaiz uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Johan thong sungah kikhia nai lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Johan’ nungzuite in siangtho biakna thu Judah mi khat tawh a kiseel uh ciangin,
Johan kiangah a pai uh a, “Rabbi aw, Jordan gun gal khatah nangmah tawh a omkhawm, ama thu teci na pan’na pa in baptaiz a, mi khempeuh ama kiangah a pai uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Johan in, “Vantung panin a kipiak kei leh, kuamah in bangmah a ngah thei kei hi.
Keimah in Khazih ka hi kei hi. Khazih mai-ah hong paipa ka hi hi ke’n kong ci zo a, note zong ka teci na hi uh hi.
Zipipa in zi neipa ahi hi. Ahih hangin zi neipa kiangah ding a, ama thu a za a lawmpa in zi pipa’ aw a zak manin a lungdam mahmah hi. Tua mah bangin keima lungdamna a kicing hi.
Tua pa in lian semsem ding a, kei ka kiam semsem ding hi,” a ci hi.
A tung pan hong kumpa in na khempeuh tungah a uk hi. Leitungah a hong piang mi in leitung mi hi a, leitung thu a gen hi. Vantung pan hong paipa in na khempeuh tungah a uk hi.
A muhsa leh a zaksa thute teci a pang hi. Kuamah in ama teci pan’na thu a mang kei uh hi.
Ama teci pan’na thu a mangte in, Pasian in thuman thutak hi ci-in a ciamteh hi.
Pasian hong sawl mi in Pasian’ thu a gen hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Pasian in Kha Siangtho kiteh loin a pia hi.
Pasian in a Tapa it a, na khempeuh ama khut sungah a pia zo hi.
Tapa thu a umte khempeuh in nuntak tawntungna a nei hi. Ahih hangin Tapa a um lo mi in nuntakna a ngah kei ding hi, Pasian’ hehna in tua pa tungah a om hi.
